items.text: Improved critter movement speed and animation blending; fixed critters hovering above ground.
AI select/move commands now work on multiple animals with offset to avoid stacking; added ai.selectinrange and ai.deselectnpc console variables.
Fixed missing or disconnected navmesh in rooms behind doors, dive sites, and certain monument interiors; corrected scientist corpse collider layer to prevent blocking movement and projectiles.
Rust+ now allows team leaders to kick players from the team or for players to leave the team voluntarily.
Added decay to monument blockers with a 12‑hour grace period, per‑minute damage after, and debug commands; fixed bug that restored blocker health on server restart.
Adjusted monument blocker health: lowered HP for various rigs and silos, making them destroyable with 1 C4 or 5 satchels.
Player boats now persist timeSinceLastUsed, restoring proper decay behavior on daily‑restart servers.
Fixed water pipe spawns at odd angles and ensured gas station loot spawners reset correctly after server restarts.
Prevented looting of clipping player bodies while mounted on submarines; players must exit the submarine to loot.

Blocked moving items into furnace output slots, fixed zero‑amount fertilizer creation loop, corrected loot panel editor offset, fixed title label to "Composter", and added proper cook‑time prediction for composting.
Added Windows Terminal compatibility to the Windows server console, fixing glitchy and unusable output.
Increased crafting cost for the heavy pot helmet from 1 to 2 sheet metal and from 4 to 8 high‑quality metal.
Corrected misleading "Can't be deployed on boats" error message to only appear when placement is actually invalid.
Fixed dynamic loading of sprites in the store's item overlay, ensuring items display correctly.
Made shop tiles clickable by reassigning resource bundles and fixing stale references, improving navigation.
Corrected composting time for items that are both cookable and compostable (e.g., meat) to use the appropriate time per process.
Adjusted composter filter to accept only food items from the updated prefab/item filter setup.
Prevented compostable items that yield no compost from being placed in the composter.
Fixed a bug where empty magazines could drop twice when using third‑person view.

Added a 3‑second hold‑E requirement to equip HAB armor, preventing accidental equips; also enabled armor gib read/write, added equip effect and placeholder sound, and switched door sounds to chainlink.
Improved critter movement with correct speed values, smoother animation blending, and no hovering above ground.
AI selection commands now affect multiple livestock; offset positions prevent NPC stacking.
Scientist corpses placed on ragdoll layer, no longer blocking movement or projectiles.
Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
World objects spawn correctly: water pipes no longer appear at odd angles and gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
Players cannot loot clipping bodies while mounted on submarines; must exit the mount to loot.
Player boats now retain their usage timer, preventing decay on daily restart servers, and error messages for invalid placement are clarified.
Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.

2026-08-26.summary:
### World & Exploration
- Improved critter movement with correct speed values, smoother animation blending, and no hovering above ground.
- AI selection commands now affect multiple livestock; offset positions prevent NPC stacking.
- Scientist corpses placed on ragdoll layer, no longer blocking movement or projectiles.
- Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
- World objects spawn correctly: water pipes no longer appear at odd angles and gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
- Players cannot loot clipping bodies while mounted on submarines; must exit the mount to loot.
- Player boats now retain their usage timer, preventing decay on daily restart servers, and error messages for invalid placement are clarified.

### Combat & Damage
- Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.

items.text: Radwater now scales its damage with protection, dealing significantly more damage to fully equipped kits.
Flashlight weapon toggles on/off with right‑click, removing the previous F‑key activation.

Semi‑automatic pistol gains stronger damage falloff at range and its high‑quality material craft cost increased; SMG spawn chance slightly up and Rifle spawn chance slightly down for better mid‑game weapon balance.
Bear rug provides 100 % comfort within 2 m and regular rug within 1 m, fixing the prior 25 % solo comfort issue.
Monument blockers at Launch Site, Military Tunnels and Missile Silo have adjusted protection values and health for improved balance.
Modular car wheels now use correct models and normals, and car handling has been refined – less body roll, fewer spin‑outs, higher‑speed drifting and smoother steering.
Added rabbit animal with animation, model, and prefab.
Russian roulette DLC textures and material updated, fixing naming issues.
Hackable crates now correctly flagged and visually indicated; puzzlereset alerts suppressed after forced restart.
Group tax displayed when hovering over upkeep cost in the TC loot panel.
Event crates and server gibs now persist across server restarts; fire state saved; crate despawn time reduced to 30 minutes; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons.
Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships corrected, improving AI navigation on those vessels.
Fixed AI fleeing behavior when players jump, ensuring enemies stay engaged.
Optimized friend list refresh, eliminating lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets in large teams.
HAB armour colliders fixed for proper removal on client and server, adding a collision mesh for the frame.
WireTool now correctly overrides third‑person idle/relax running stance, fixing tool animation.
Fixed session modal overflow and description scroll, restoring ability to disconnect from long description sessions.
Store UI now avoids sprite invalidation on opening, making all shop tiles clickable and fixing missing icons.
Added support for dynamic fullscreen and gallery sprites in store item overlays, improving item preview rendering.
Siren off state now visible, clarifying when sirens are inactive.
Cover images in store items now enabled after initialization, ensuring proper visuals.
Restored DLC prefab setup to prevent errors when clicking DLC tiles in the store.
Improved dynamic shop asset loading; empty tiles created on warmup then filled, stabilizing store UI.
